author: reek
body: Two things had to be true for this to run, and only one of them was. The emulator copied the frame into the guest buffer and then posted no transfer event at all, so a driver that queued a TRB and waited for its completion waited forever -- data arriving with nothing to say it had arrived, which is the stub-that-agrees-with-itself shape and is indistinguishable from a dead camera.

author: reek
body: The `read` line and the pixel lines are not redundant, which the negative control is what shows. Delete the emulator's event post and the pixels still come out right, because the data lands whether or not anything says it did; only `read` goes to -2. Delete the copy instead and `read` stays 0 while the pixels go to zero. Each line fails alone for a different reason, so neither can stand in for the other.
